a11y.apg: No APG pattern for pagination; the practice adopted is a <nav> with an accessible name holding two real buttons. Previous and Next disable themselves at the ends, so the keyboard never reaches a control that would do nothing. The page counter between them is a Badge — text, not a target.
a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 29/08/2026 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). This ficha comes from the lineage that did not have check 30, so it declared keys with no measurement behind them — the merge of the two lineages on 29/08/2026 is what surfaced it. Confirmed: Enter and Space, which activate the focused page button and change the page. There are deliberately no arrow keys: the pages are a row of buttons in document order, not a widget that owns a roving selection. Tab and Shift+Tab are out of the count on both sides by construction: Tab moves focus anywhere on a page, so it never distinguishes one component from another. What this measurement establishes is that there is no ENGINE keyboard here to measure — the keyboard is the document order, which is the correct answer for this component.

props.name: total
props.description: How many PAGES there are, not how many rows. Previous and Next disable themselves at the ends.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Receives the page to go to, already computed. Controlled: the component does not hold the number, because whoever fetches the data is the one who knows it.
